title: SignPlate
description: This project adds the ability to make predefined signs and when placed it will place the sign with the predefined text.
body:
SignPlate lets you create predefined signs and place them instantly in your world. No more typing the same text over and over, just open the menu, pick your sign, and place it with one click.

![SignPlate Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2c8f9e00019402476cb1aab8ab157513fe3436a_0.webp)
